correctness.rationale: Projection W=im F with complement ker F gives m_s=[n s]_q q^{s(n-s)}. For fixed rank-r E, EF=0 and FE=0 each count [n-r s]_q q^{s(n-s)}, while their intersection counts [n-r s]_q q^{s(n-r-s)}. Inclusion-exclusion proves D. Nested coordinate projections have strict neighborhood inclusion by a rank-one witness. Min degree 2q^{n-1}-1 has multiplicity q^{n-1}[n 1]_q, so exact algebra recovers q and n. Boundaries n=2, s>n-r and q even checked. Standalone exhaustive program independently checked 699372 ordered pairs in seven dimensions/fields, including GF4. Finite enumeration is corroboration, not general proof.

value.rationale: The same natural idempotent annihilation graph has a dimension-dependent symmetry break: regular precisely in size two and strictly rank-stratified in all higher matrix sizes. More importantly, two unlabelled graph statistics distinguish every full matrix ring over finite fields, a structural recognition invariant not supplied by previous cardinality or directed-triangle counts. It is a uniform infinite-family theorem, not a tiny table increment or pure parameter substitution.
